name: Lowerniel Drakan
note: Final-battle hallowed-flail baseline: vampyre accuracy/damage and a 26–28 per-hit limit. Dodges, counter-attacks, phase timing, Vampyrium supplies and incoming damage are not scored.

name: Ranis Drakan
note: Ivandis-flail body baseline with its vampyre damage bonus. Airborne periods, vyrewatch adds, blood healing and incoming damage are not scored.

name: Vanstrom Klause
note: Blisterwood-flail body baseline with vampyre accuracy/damage. Blood-orb damage, healing, lightning, the final phase and incoming damage are not scored.

name: Fragment of Seren
note: Vulnerable-body Magic baseline with the 22–24 per-splat limiter. Healing beams, clones, near-max-HP attacks, movement and full-fight supplies are not scored.

name: Galvek
note: Ranged baseline across Fire/Air/Water/Earth, 300 HP each. Dragonbane and bolt effects apply. Phase-local debuffs do not carry across forms; dragonfire protection, movement and incoming attacks are not scored.

name: Sliske's wights
quest: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire
note: Sliske himself is not the combat target. One usable owned style must damage all four wights; the weakest body's DPS determines readiness. Clones, adds, specials, leech healing and recoil are not assumed.

name: Elvarg
note: Quest-body damage baseline. Dragonfire protection, positioning, incoming damage and supplies are not scored.

name: Jungle Demon
note: Quest-body ranged/Magic baseline. Gnome assistance, safespots and incoming attacks are not scored.

name: Kruk
note: Quest-body damage baseline. Flinching, kiting, cave navigation and incoming attacks are not scored.

name: Glough
note: Ordinary quest-body damage baseline. Attack-range safespots, room transitions, teleports, incoming attacks and movement uptime are not scored.

name: Robert the Strong
note: Quest-body melee baseline using recorded crush defence. Pillar cover, specials and incoming damage are not scored.

name: Vorkath (Quest)
note: 460-HP quest-body baseline, separate from the 750-HP post-quest boss. Acid, freeze/spawn attacks, dragonfire protection and incoming damage are not scored.

name: Xamphur
note: Vulnerable quest-body baseline. Falling hands, corruption, adds and movement uptime are not scored.

name: Surok Magis
note: Cast-spell baseline; powered staves and melee/ranged are blocked. Counter-spells, draining attacks, special timing and incoming damage are not scored.

name: Barrelchest
note: Original quest-body baseline. Prayer disruption, positioning, incoming damage and supplies are not scored.

name: Damis
note: Both original quest forms use their own recorded stats. The weakest form determines readiness; prayer drain, safespots and incoming attacks are not scored.

name: Fareed
note: Water-spell or physical baseline with owned ice gloves to prevent disarming. Other Magic is blocked. Ammunition loss, incoming attacks and movement are not scored.

name: Kamil
note: Fire spells or physical damage; other Magic is blocked. Cold stat drains, freezing, travel supplies and incoming attacks are not scored.

name: Dessous
note: Tier-1 vampyre body: ordinary weapons work and reviewed flails receive vampyre bonuses. Teleports, blood attacks and incoming damage are not scored.

name: Duke Sucellus (Quest)
quest: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire
note: 330-HP awake quest-body baseline with 70% Demonbane effectiveness. Preparation, poison, movement uptime and incoming attacks are not scored.

name: Vardorvis (Quest)
quest: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire
note: Quest body: 500 HP, Defence 180→130 and Strength 210→280 as HP falls. Readiness uses full-HP defence; axes, head attacks, movement and incoming damage are not scored.

name: The Leviathan (Quest)
quest: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire
note: 720-HP ordinary quest-body baseline with melee immunity. Stuns, rear damage bonuses, enrage, prayer execution and incoming attacks are not scored.

name: The Whisperer (Quest)
quest: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire
note: 660-HP ordinary quest-body baseline. Special damage reductions, healing/enrage, sanity, souls and incoming damage are not scored.
